title: AARO director says AARO works with UARCs and FFRDCs

tellings.quote: as recently as 2024, the new AROW director John Kazowski said that Arrow is working with both UARS and FFRDC's.

plain: At a 2024 Senate hearing where Senator Kirsten Gillibrand was questioning him, Jon Kosloski, director of AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), said his office works with UARCs and FFRDCs, university-affiliated and federally funded research centres that do contract work for the government. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb points to this on the show because such centres are where he and others suspect secret UFO work could be housed.
